lede: The biggest thing to watch this week is a special meeting at Telluride Medical Center on Monday, where the board takes up a proposal to engage Jensen Partners for due diligence with CommonSpirit Health — one of the country's largest nonprofit hospital systems — a step that signals a potential affiliation or transaction could be moving forward. On Tuesday, the Ecology Commission considers a draft ordinance that would ban gas-powered lawn and garden equipment in town limits by 2028–2030. The rest of the week fills out with the Warren Miller ski film, Art Walk, and the library's Adult Spelling Bee.
